title: From Bochner to the Lichnerowicz bound
audience: The reader uses a Riemannian gradient, covariant Hessian, orthonormal frames and the divergence theorem. The exact spectral existence and scalar Bochner identity are imported explicitly; trace Cauchy-Schwarz and their integral connection are derived here.
reader_goals: Recover the complete normalized Lichnerowicz lower bound with the nonnegative Laplacian.
Execute the Bochner integration, trace estimate, eigenfunction substitution and justified division.
Identify the first failures in dimension one, with a boundary, or when the Hessian is discarded.
prerequisites: Smooth Riemannian gradient, Levi-Civita connection and orthonormal frame.
Integration of divergence on a closed manifold, interpreted using the volume density.

required_steps: State the precise spectral and Bochner imports with the nonnegative Laplacian convention.
